# Prefix rules match words and have no wildcard token, so some forms pass: a wrapper option whose
# value is open-ended, such as `sudo -u <someone other than root>` or a duration outside the listed
# set; a script with comments, redirects, assignments or substitutions, which Codex leaves unsplit
# (bash.rs:36-50); a push to a remote other than origin; and `export -p`, a bash declaration that is
# never a plain command (tree-sitter/tree-sitter-bash@v0.25.1 a06c2e44, grammar.js:461-468). A
# script that pushes inside is not seen either: main's ruleset stays the server-side guard.
